name: report.tbx/tesla-vin-report
title: Tesla VIN Report
description: Check a used Tesla by VIN: what Tesla's record says about FSD, the computer, the pack.

tools.name: check_tesla_vin
tools.description: Check a used Tesla by its VIN. Use it when someone gives you a 17-character Tesla VIN, for example from a listing. From Tesla's own record for that car it returns whether Full Self-Driving is on it, the Autopilot computer, the battery pack and the build date. It also returns the model, model year and plant from the VIN, the number of NHTSA recalls and of Tesla's service bulletins for the model year, and links for the person. On free Supercharging it gives the rule for a car that cannot have it. For a Model S or Model X built before April 2017 it says the answer is in the paid Factory Report, with that report's link. For a Model S of 2012 to 2016 or a 2016 Model X it also returns the paid Service Report, which goes through those service bulletins for the car, with its link and a sample. It does not cover battery health, accidents, title history or mileage. Read-only and free, within a daily limit.

vin.description: The car's 17-character VIN, as on the listing or the label in the driver's door frame.

tools.name: explain_tesla_option_code
tools.description: Explain one Tesla factory option code, such as APPF, APFB, APH4, BT85 or SC01. Use it when someone asks what a code on a Tesla's build sheet or listing means. Returns the meaning in plain English, what it means for a buyer where known, related codes and a page to read more. It does not look up any car. A code with no explanation here returns the error unknown_code.

code.description: One factory option code, for example APPF or BT85.

tools.name: used_tesla_buyer_guide
tools.description: What to check before buying a used Tesla of one model and model year, for example a 2016 Model S. Returns the short answer, the main checks with one line each, the free-Supercharging rule for those cars, the Autopilot and media computers they were built with, and the page to read. For the years the paid Service Report is sold for, it says what that report adds, with a sample. It does not look up any car: check_tesla_vin answers for one car, by its VIN.
